task-orchestrator.description: Exposes task lifecycle tools (advance phase, ask user, register PR, ...). Reads TASK_ID and BACKEND_URL from the env that the orchestrator backend sets at spawn time.

playwright.description: Headless browser driver for the ui_verification phase. Lets the agent navigate/click/fill/screenshot the running app to verify it works. Only use these tools in the ui_verification phase. Requires Chromium installed in the runtime (npx playwright install chromium, one-time host setup).
